You'll find the correct channel for reaching your local IKEA below. IKEA of Sweden AB SE-34381 Älmhult IKEA.com Raise a concern The IKEA business is based on honesty, respect, fairness, and integrity – and we take actions that go against these values seriously. If, despite best efforts, you witness or experience misconduct or legal breaches, we encourage you to raise your concern with us. Inter IKEA Group For concerns regarding breaches or misconduct related to the Inter IKEA Group code of conduct, or breaches of laws or regulations. Raise a concern IKEA supply chain For the reporting of misconduct anywhere in the IKEA supply chain, if it is not possible to speak to a manager.
